name: Mini Mart Survivors
storyline:
Mini Mart Survivors is a convenience store roguelite. You take the night shift at SHIFT24, a chain with unusually good pay, and you find out why.

A shift runs about 10 minutes. Customers arrive in waves that keep growing, your clerk attacks on their own while you handle the movement, and the night's boss is waiting at the end. Everything you fight with comes off the shelves: instant noodles, snacks, coffee, hot dogs, and a few things that were never meant to leave the store.

6 branches around the world
Seoul, Texas, Sapporo, Copenhagen, Dubai and Hong Kong. Each one has its own customers, its own boss and its own disaster. Tornadoes, blizzards, sandstorms and floods all arrive while you are still on the clock.

Everything in the store is a weapon
Collect Soul Flames to level up, pick a weapon or an upgrade from three cards, and evolve it when the right pair lines up.

Pay off your debt, choose your ending
Your pay lands in the SHIFT24 account, and the office ATM is where you decide how much of the debt to clear. How much you repay and what you uncover decide how your story ends. Will you get out of SHIFT24, or become part of it?
summary: SHIFT24 is a mysterious convenience store chain. As night deepens, strange customers swarm endlessly. Ramen, snacks, and coffee become weapons. Fight them off, and clues hidden in branches worldwide begin to emerge. Follow the clues and pay down your debt to uncover the truth behind SHIFT24.
